steps.heading: Set up
steps.caption: Cover the table. Start with the printed outline. Use thin coats; rinse and blot brushes between colors.

steps.heading: Blend the sky
steps.caption: Mix white with blue for the upper sky. Below, blend yellow into orange, then red plus white. Work horizontally around the outlines.

steps.heading: Light the sunset
steps.caption: Mix white with yellow for the sun and bright cloud streaks. Mix white with red for softer streaks. Let the sky dry.

steps.heading: Layer distant ridges
steps.caption: Mix blue with white for the far ridges. Use less white in each nearer ridge. Follow the printed curves; let adjoining bands dry.

steps.heading: Deepen the valley
steps.caption: Mix blue with green and a little black. Fill the nearest forest slopes. Tap upward with the small brush for pointed treetops.

steps.heading: Block in the rocks
steps.caption: Mix black, brown and a little white. Brush this gray-brown base across the rock slabs. Leave the printed fallen leaves white.

steps.heading: Paint the tree
steps.caption: Mix brown with a little black. Fill the trunk and branches with lengthwise strokes. Keep the foliage white. Let the base dry.

steps.heading: Build autumn color
steps.caption: Mix red with a little brown. Dab into the canopy and shrubs. Add orange over most areas, leaving darker pockets visible.

steps.heading: Lift the leaves
steps.caption: Mix orange with yellow. Tap small clusters along the lit foliage edges, leaving gaps. Use red, orange and yellow on fallen leaves.

steps.heading: Catch the bark light
steps.caption: Mix brown with yellow and a little white. Drag a nearly dry small brush along the trunk's left edge and branch tops.

steps.heading: Define the ledges
steps.caption: Mix white with a little black and brown. Skim the upper rock edges with a nearly dry brush. Keep the dark cracks visible.

steps.heading: Dry and clean up
steps.caption: Lay the canvas flat until fully dry. Wash and reshape brushes, wipe the palette and close the paint pots.

steps.heading: Prepare your space
steps.caption: Protect your table. Follow the preprinted lines. Use thin coats; rinse and blot brushes between colors.

steps.heading: Lay in the sky
steps.caption: Mix blue with a little black. Paint only the sky around the flowers and greenery. Keep all plant shapes white.

steps.heading: Turn the blue swirls
steps.caption: Mix blue with white. Follow the sky curves with short strokes, leaving darker gaps. Let dry.

steps.heading: Light the stars
steps.caption: Mix white with a little yellow. Dab star centers and curved light trails. Keep some blue showing.

steps.heading: Paint both flowers
steps.caption: Paint every petal yellow, from its base toward its tip. Keep seed heads and greenery white. Let dry.

steps.heading: Warm the folds
steps.caption: Brush orange along petal bases and one side of each fold. Blend into yellow with outward strokes.

steps.heading: Paint stems and leaves
steps.caption: Mix green with a little blue. Fill stems, leaves and curled flower backs, following their length.

steps.heading: Fill the seed heads
steps.caption: Mix brown with a little black. Fill both seed heads; use small dabs along the rims. Let dry.

steps.heading: Shape the greenery
steps.caption: Mix green with yellow for light edges. Mix green with blue and a speck of black for shadows. Pull curved strokes.

steps.heading: Lift the petals
steps.caption: Mix yellow with a little white. Pull slender highlights from base to tip on dry petals; leave orange folds visible.

steps.heading: Stipple the seeds
steps.caption: Dab brown, orange and yellow onto dry seed heads. Mix white with yellow for a few bright dots. Keep dark gaps.

steps.heading: Dry and clean up
steps.caption: Lay the canvas flat until fully dry. Wash and reshape brushes, wipe the palette and close the paint pots.
